$comment: Identifier taxonomy registry for SecB_PF (SECB-WP-FWK-041). Adopted from BACP v1.1 TaxonomyModel section 6: identifier ladders are versioned DATA with stable IDs and namespaces, not assumptions spread across prose. This file records WHAT IS BOUND. It does not assert a new rule -- binding agent behaviour is an act on the authority surface and belongs to the constitutional authority, not to an executor adding a config file. What this file does buy, today, is that a prefix collision becomes a failing test instead of a discovery made three messages later: tests/test_identifier_taxonomy.py.

ladders.bound_to: Change classes -- the authority delta a diff carries
Authority ladder tiers -- how much an agent may land without fresh approval
ladders.ordering: ascending authority; A3/A4 require an active ballot layer

ladders.bound_to: Risk tiers -- how much damage a change can do
ladders.ordering: ascending damage; an agent may not lower its own tier

ladders.bound_to: Evidence levels -- how strong the assurance behind a claim is
ladders.ordering: ascending strength; E4 is production telemetry and SecB holds none

ladders.bound_to: Decision classes -- who decides, as distinct from who may land it (G) or how much damage (R)
Governance layers -- L0 root constitution, L1 delegation envelope, L2 policy implementation, L3 operational
ladders.enforced_by: reading; L0 is also the constitution's filename

ladders.bound_to: Conflict impact ladder -- how much a specification conflict costs to resolve
ladders.ordering: ascending impact; C4 is constitutional-authority-only, C5 is refused
none -- a taxonomy, not a ladder

ladders.enforced_by: recount from source at each report

ladders.bound_to: Traceability exceptions -- a requirement that cannot acquire verification here
Decision packets issued to the constitutional authority
Independent review records -- the only E3 artifacts SecB holds

ladders.home: GitHub issues; prefix is configuration since SECB-WP-FWK-036

meanings: C-1..C-3 = the three conflicts named in docs/17-references/FIT-HDG-EAB.md
collisions_recorded.evidenced_by: SECB-WP-FWK-037 wrote both 'impact C4' and 'C-4 governance owner' in one work package; the third meaning was found by SECB-WP-FWK-039's duplicate check
collisions_recorded.disposition: OPEN -- rename candidates are the two non-ladder uses, since C0-C5 is the ordered ladder and the others are registers. Operator's call: renaming a condition ID rewrites decision records that cite it.

collisions_recorded.evidenced_by: both merged and in force since SECB-WP-FWK-026
collisions_recorded.disposition: OPEN -- the deferred-capability list is the cheaper rename; it is a plan, not a control, and nothing enforces on its IDs.

meanings: E0-E4 = expansion classes (proposed by FPSA v1.0, NOT adopted)
collisions_recorded.evidenced_by: SECB-WP-FWK-039; bOPEN resolved the same collision by writing 'expansion class E-n' set-qualified at every use
collisions_recorded.disposition: BLOCKED -- expansion classes may not enter SecB as bare E-n. Either set-qualify per bOPEN's ratified precedent, or take a free prefix.

meanings: L0-L3 = governance layers, and L0 is the constitution's filename (in force)
L0-L4 = metamodel / domain models / policy profile / runtime instance / evidence record (proposed by BACP v1.1 section 1, NOT adopted)
collisions_recorded.distinguisher: none if adopted, and L2 would mean two things that sound alike
collisions_recorded.disposition: BLOCKED -- BACP's artifact layers may not enter SecB as bare L-n. Reserved alternative below.

reserved_unbound.reserved_for: BACP v1.1 artifact layers -- metamodel, domain models, policy profile, runtime instance, evidence record
reserved_unbound.status: RESERVED, NOT ADOPTED. Recorded so the next work package does not have to rediscover that L is taken. Adoption of BACP is a separate decision.

notes: Every prefix above is recorded because it is IN USE, verified by grep at as_of_commit. Nothing here is aspirational.

The test guarding this file asserts two things: no prefix is bound twice outside collisions_recorded, and every recorded collision carries a disposition. It freezes the debt and blocks its growth; it does not pretend the debt is paid.

This registry is data. The rule 'a single-letter prefix, once bound, is never rebound' was recommended by SECB-WP-FWK-039 and is NOT enacted here -- a rule that binds agent behaviour belongs to the constitutional authority.
